before.message: Pin versions in apt get install. Instead of `apt-get install <package>` use `apt-get install <package>=<version>`
Use ./*glob* or -- *glob* so names with dashes won't become options.

after.message: Pin versions in apt get install. Instead of `apt-get install <package>` use `apt-get install <package>=<version>`
Use ./*glob* or -- *glob* so names with dashes won't become options.
